build.ppc_source: Existing local PPC archive reused with LO_PREBUILT_RECOMP_LIBRARY; both runs used the same executable and archive.
build.provenance_limit: The archive was not rebuilt or independently provenance-audited. The executable's embedded revision predates the commits of the tested source changes.

scene_smoke.isolation: Separate copies of the same save/profile/settings seed and separate writable caches; shared read-only game and shader-pack inputs.
scene_smoke.route: Continue to Map 20, Uhra - Residential Area; send a Y-button pulse to open the main menu.
scene_smoke.observed: Both runs reached the scene, rendered the player and environment, and opened the same main menu without an observed crash. Captures were visually inspected; scene animation timing was not synchronized.
scene_smoke.evidence_directory: External scratch: semantic-runtime-scenes-20261002; each run retains runtime.log, settings, input requests and captures.

acceptance_limits: No per-entry execution coverage was collected; this does not establish scene acceptance for all 1238 available wrappers.
The remaining recovered memory and CRT families are not connected to this runtime experiment.
No pixel-exact comparison, performance benchmark, combat, transition, failure-path, concurrency, MMIO or cross-platform acceptance is claimed.
Runtime replacements remain disabled by default; full semantic recovery and full-game acceptance remain incomplete.
